item.title: Bulletin updated at 05:50 HKT 18/Oct/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The anticyclone aloft will continue to bring generally fine weather to Guangdong today. An intense northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Winds will strengthen from the north over the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Fengshen will edge closer to the vicinity of Luzon and intensify gradually today. It will enter the central and northern parts of the South China Sea afterwards. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, Fengshen will turn to a southwesterly track gradually and begin to weaken midweek next week, but there are uncertainties in the location of the turn. Under the combined effect of the monsoon and Fengshen, it will be persistently windy with rain and temperatures will fall appreciably over the coast of southern China early to midweek next week. There will be swells.
